content_of_post_to_comment:
26M here. Title says it all. I don't know how to live. The amount of time i've spent on the internet since childhood has made me feel as if i've been left completely left behinde in everything.

Before the internet, i would spend some hours a day on tv when I was a kid. Mostly because of boredome and because my parents would be pretty absent, always complaining about stuff or fighing and being hysteric, we are a numerour family. I would still go outside and play with other kids, but I always found myself unable to really socialize with others, I would try and fail. I give fault about this to my family being really disfunctional. Don't get me wrong, It could be worse, but i never liked it. Anyway, i was aware of how much junk tv had so I would try to at least watch infotainment. This is a big trap i couldn't have known about. Eventually I moved on the internet, since I had more freedom and could watch what i wanted, becoming essentially addicted to youtube. Eventually i found out porn and internet forums. I stopped goign to school in high school since I hated the environment and couldn't find any friends, and began spending 15 hours a day on the internet. I would wake up open my pc and spend my time looking thhings up . I think i've seen the worst things that can be published in those years. And probably fucked me up pretty badly. I spend 6 years as a hikikimori spending all my time on the itnernet. It was just trying to run away from reality and not wanting to face my problems, and all the problems that others created for me. I manged to finish high school 2 years later of my peers, by being homeschooled. Altoug I would really study the minimum, since I had reaally bad memories of school and in general studying because of my teachers and my parents, always pushing me to study harder and never really caring about what i wanted, but only about what I had to do. I maneged to enter univestiry somehow , and oh boy i felt like a total alien between other students. I felt like i was wasting space and air there. At this point I was already aware of my problems, my internet and porn addiction. I had managed to get rid of my gaming addiction by deleting all my account on all the games i was playing.But i would still pass a lot of time on forums and reddit. I wasn't really learning anything, just consuming all the information I could find on the internet, without really going deep in them. I knew a lot of things but superficially, y'know, jack of all trades master of none. In university obviously i had a looot of trouble even only getting to know people because of my past as a hikki. I knew I had to push myself out of the hole that i built for myself so i tried hard to be around people. While i got to know a lot of people during these years, no one really stuck with me. No one really wanted to be friends. I always felt like it was superficial interactions. Everyone managed to find some group to belong to. But i just couldn't. Now that i've finished uni, i don't even know how to live. I can't socialize, i can't concentrate, I have zero discipline, I'm still addicted to the internet, I can't face my problems. I failed at life. The only thing I have left is the thing that destroyed me. My addiction.
